# datarobot_group (Data Source)

Looks up a directory group by name and returns its ID, so that group memberships and shares can be expressed by name rather than by hardcoded ID.

Names are matched in full and case sensitively, so the name must be given exactly as it appears in the identity provider. Results are scoped to the caller's organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "datarobot_group" "finance" {
  name = "FinanceTeam"
}

output "finance_group_id" {
  value = data.datarobot_group.finance.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the group, matched in full and case sensitively.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the group, or null if none is set.
- `id` (String) The ID of the group.
- `provisioning_source` (String) How the group is provisioned: `scim` when synced from an external identity provider, `local` when created in DataRobot.
